hero.title: Onchain, in plain language.
hero.subtitle: Your copilot for KeeperHub. Ask anything and it answers instantly — but nothing that moves value ever just happens. <highlight>It stops, shows you the exact action, and waits.</highlight>
hero.enterHint: press enter to open in the app

heading.title: Reads flow. Writes stop and ask.
heading.subtitle: Ask a question and it answers instantly. Ask it to move value and it stops, fills in every field, and waits for you to click.

registry.title: Generated, not hand-written.
registry.description: Swaps, transfers, lending, staking, bridges, price feeds, wallets, allowances, alerts — 442 actions across 34 integrations, generated from KeeperHub's own registry and pinned to a snapshot hash.

effect.title: The gate is derived.
effect.description: Every action is classified by effect from the registry itself — 292 read, 148 move value or grant authority. Anything the classifier cannot place is quarantined and refuses to run.

confirm.title: What you approve is what runs.
confirm.description: A write stops the chat and prints a card: every field filled in, every field editable. Simulated first where the platform can preview, marked plainly where it cannot. What you approved is what executes, byte for byte.

failLoudly.title: A receipt. Not an ack.
failLoudly.description: Success is a verified on-chain receipt — block, hash, status, read back from the chain. A tool that returns ok has not moved anything yet.

voice.title: Voice can ask. Voice cannot send.
voice.description: Speak a question, speak a preview — voice does both. Confirming a write takes a deliberate click on the card.

ledger.title: The record outlives the chat.
ledger.description: Every execution is written as a durable fact separate from the transcript, so deleting a conversation never deletes the evidence. Amounts stay integer base-unit strings end to end and are formatted only at the edge.

heading.title: From a sentence to a verified receipt.
heading.subtitle: Five steps. Reads flow. Writes stop and ask.

ask.title: You ask, in plain language
ask.body: No SDK, no ABI, no calldata. Type the thing you actually want done, and the copilot reads it as intent rather than as a command.

resolve.title: It resolves the action
resolve.body: 442 actions across 34 integrations, generated from KeeperHub's own registry and snapshot-hashed. Each one is classified by effect: 292 read, 148 move value or grant authority.

gate.title: Reads flow. Writes stop.
gate.body: A read answers immediately — nothing is at stake. Anything that moves value renders a card instead: every field filled in, every field editable.

confirm.title: You check it and confirm
confirm.body: The arguments freeze the moment the card renders. What executes is byte-for-byte what you approved, not whatever the model says next.

receipt.title: You get a receipt
receipt.body: Success is a verified on-chain receipt, never a tool acknowledgement — kept as a durable record, so deleting the conversation never deletes the evidence.

heading.title: One key into your KeeperHub.
heading.subtitle: A kh_ key with mcp:write scope connects any MCP client you already run. The copilot itself signs in with KeeperHub, so it needs only its own settings.

finalCta.title: Reads flow. Writes stop and ask.
finalCta.body: Ask anything and the answer comes back immediately. Ask it to move value and it stops, fills in every field, and waits for your click.

footer.tagline: reads flow, writes stop and ask
